title: StrategyRefContract
description: Canonical contract for Strategy Registry reference fields in Agora workshops. Defines three identities, create-from-draft semantics, free-form semantics, version-link creation, deprecated aliases, and conclude semantics per AG-BE-SW-001 deep-closure §5.

strategy_ref_input.title: StrategyRefInput
strategy_ref_input.description: Optional strategy reference supplied by the caller when creating a workshop from an existing Registry draft. Both fields are optional; omitting both produces a free-form workshop.

strategy_id.description: Stable strategy identity across versions. When supplied the BFF verifies that the resolved Registry record.strategy_id matches this value; mismatch returns 409 STRATEGY_REFERENCE_MISMATCH.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Immutable Registry record/version ID to link. BFF resolves this record, verifies tenant/user scope, and on success stores strategy_id + active_strategy_spec_registry_id on the workshop. The StrategySpec JSON is NOT copied into workshop tables.

workshop_strategy_projection.title: WorkshopStrategyProjection
workshop_strategy_projection.description: Strategy-reference fields on a workshop session response. Represents the workshop's live pointers into the Strategy Registry; not a copy of StrategySpec content.

strategy_id.description: Stable strategy identity. NULL when the workshop was created free-form and no Registry draft has been accepted yet.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Deprecated alias for active_strategy_spec_registry_id. Emitted for backward compatibility; consumers should prefer active_strategy_spec_registry_id.

active_strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Authoritative Registry pointer: the currently selected (active) immutable Registry version. NULL until a Registry version is linked. Selection changes only this pointer; the Registry record itself is not modified.

active_workshop_version_id.description: The currently selected WorkshopVersionLink ID. Changes when the user calls the version-select route.

selected_version_id.description: Deprecated alias for active_workshop_version_id. Emitted for backward compatibility; consumers should prefer active_workshop_version_id.

workshop_conclude_refs.title: WorkshopConcludeRefs
workshop_conclude_refs.description: Final strategy reference fields recorded when a workshop is concluded. Conclude stores these immutable pointers but does NOT promote the StrategySpec lifecycle state. Registry/governance transitions (draft → candidate → approved) remain the Strategy Registry's responsibility.

final_workshop_version_id.description: The WorkshopVersionLink that represents the concluded Registry version.

final_strategy_spec_registry_id.description: The immutable Registry version ID at conclusion. This is a reference, not a lifecycle action.

first_version_link_request.title: FirstVersionLinkRequest
first_version_link_request.description: Payload for creating the first Registry draft and workshop-version link from a free-form workshop. Uses the existing Strategy Registry draft-create path; the Registry is the single source of truth.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: The newly created Registry record/version ID returned by the Strategy Registry draft-create call. BFF links this into the workshop and updates active_strategy_spec_registry_id.

idempotency_key.description: Client idempotency key for the version-link creation operation.

source_event_id.description: The workshop event that triggered this version link, if any.

STRATEGY_REFERENCE_MISMATCH.description: Supplied strategy_id does not match the strategy_id on the resolved Registry record. Never includes Registry contents in the error response.

STRATEGY_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.description: No accessible Registry record found for the supplied strategy_spec_registry_id. Response must not reveal whether the record exists under a different tenant or user.

WORKSHOP_VERSION_REQUIRED.description: Conclude requires an existing workshop-version link; none is present.

WORKSHOP_ALREADY_CONCLUDED.description: Operation rejected because the workshop is already concluded.

WORKSHOP_ARCHIVED.description: Operation rejected because the workshop is archived (terminal state).

create_from_draft_semantics.title: CreateFromDraftSemantics
create_from_draft_semantics.description: Machine-readable record of the BFF create-from-draft resolution steps per §5.2. NOT a runtime payload; included for contract documentation only.

step_1_resolve_registry_record.const: BFF reads the Strategy Registry record by strategy_spec_registry_id

step_2_verify_scope.const: BFF verifies tenant/user scope; missing or unauthorized returns 404/403 without revealing cross-user existence

step_3_verify_strategy_id_match.const: If strategy_id was supplied, BFF verifies record.strategy_id matches; mismatch returns 409 STRATEGY_REFERENCE_MISMATCH

step_4_store_pointers_only.const: BFF stores strategy_id and active_strategy_spec_registry_id only; StrategySpec JSON is NOT copied into workshop tables

free_form_semantics.title: FreeFormSemantics
free_form_semantics.description: Machine-readable record of free-form workshop creation semantics per §5.3. NOT a runtime payload.

first_accepted_version.const: Call existing Strategy Registry draft-create; receive strategy_id and strategy_spec_registry_id; insert workshop-version link; update workshop active pointer atomically

no_duplicate_strategy_spec.const: Free-form workshops never create a StrategySpec outside the Strategy Registry; the Registry is always the authority

description: Top-level document. Bundles all strategy-reference contract definitions for machine-readable consumption by BFF, contract tests, and code generators.

three_canonical_identities.description: The three stable identifiers that relate a workshop to the Strategy Registry.

strategy_id.description: Stable strategy identity across all Registry versions. Set once from the Registry record; does not change when the operator selects a different Registry version.

strategy_spec_registry_id.description: Immutable Registry record/version ID. Each draft, revision, or accepted version has its own strategy_spec_registry_id. A workshop stores only a pointer to this ID.

active_strategy_spec_registry_id.description: The currently selected Registry version on the workshop session. Mutable; changes when the user selects a different version. This is the live pointer; active_workshop_version_id is its companion workshop-side identifier.
